case_name: Smt. Renuka Yadav v. Mohan Yadav
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife seeks transfer of divorce petition filed by respondent-husband from Family Court, Bharatpur to Family Court, Jaipur.

legal_principles.principle: A party's financial condition can be a relevant factor in considering an application for transfer of case.
legal_principles.held: Counsel has further argued that the petitioner is not having any independent source of income and she is not in a position to spend huge travelling expenses for every date of hearing.

legal_principles.principle: A party's ability to appear before the court is a relevant factor in considering an application for transfer of case.
legal_principles.held: Counsel has further argued that the petitioner is not in a position to appear before the learned Family Court, Bharatpur for defending the case on each and every date.

legal_principles.principle: The distance between the parties' residences is a relevant factor in considering an application for transfer of case.
legal_principles.held: Counsel has contended that the distance between Jaipur City to Bharatpur is only 183 kilometers and various transportation means are available to travel to Bhratpur for attending the case.

outcome.final_order: Transfer application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 allowed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
